title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Blue Razz Mojito 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Blue Razz Mojito by Doozy Infinity fuses tangy Blue Raspberry with the unmistakable zesty freshness of a sophisticated Mojito cocktail. The vibrant Blue Raspberry brings a sweet-sour burst up front, balanced by a zingy streak of Lime and a touch of herbal Mint, capturing the bright, refreshing spirit of a classic Mojito. A smooth wave of cool Ice on the exhale adds clarity and keeps the flavour sharp and beautifully defined from start to finish. This 50VG/50PG e-liquid is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, pens and compact refillable devices. The 120ml shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with enough space to add two 10ml nic shots for a customised strength. Doozy Infinity Podfills offer a satisfying way to enjoy 50/50 blends in larger bottles — perfect for fans of smooth throat hits and vibrant flavour.
